# Showroom adviser portraits (AI-generated)

Ten head-and-shoulders portraits for the digital kiosks of the ten showroom advisers, in `public/yas-bloom/staff/<adviserId>.webp` (768x1024, WebP quality 86, 38 to 73 KB each). The ids are the ones in `src/showroom3d/staff/roster.js` on `claude/web-realism-3`.

**These are fictional faces generated by an image model. They are not real people, not employees and not based on anyone's likeness.** The UI must label each one "AI-generated portrait" next to the existing "(AI)" adviser label. No name was used in any prompt.

## How they were made

- Model: `gpt_image_2_6` (GPT Image 2.6) through the Higgsfield MCP, `quality: low`, `resolution: 1k`, `aspect_ratio: 3:4`, output 880x1168 PNG, then fitted to 768x1024 and saved as WebP locally.
- Cost: **0.25 credits per image, 2.5 credits for the set** (the cheapest photoreal option that was actually available: Seedream 5.0 Flash is 0.5 per image, which the remaining balance could not cover for ten; `z_image` at 0.15 failed to run on this account earlier the same day; the account has no unlimited allowance).
- One generation per adviser, no retries. All ten were viewed at full size and **all ten were accepted**: no distorted faces, eyes, teeth, ears or fabric; hands are not in frame.
- Headscarf follows the roster's look preset: six with a hijab / shayla (kitchens, walkin, bedroom, doors, studio, vip), four without (reception, wardrobes, living, lounge). Outfit colours follow the same presets in muted tones (teal or brick coat, black / plum / sand / navy abaya; cream, grey or rose scarf).
- Shared prompt frame so the set reads as one shoot: same lens, same key light direction, same blurred walnut showroom background. Each prompt varies age (late 20s to mid 40s), face shape, skin tone, hair or scarf, and outfit, so the ten are clearly different people.

## Review notes

- `lounge`: the roster's darkest skin preset was prompted as "deep brown skin"; the result is a natural, credible portrait but some viewers may read her as South Asian rather than Gulf Arab. Replace this one first if the owner wants a different look (one more image, 0.25 credits).
- `kitchens` and `doors` both wear a cream scarf (as the roster specifies) and are both in the older half of the range; they are different faces, and the abaya colours differ (black, navy).
- The portraits show a warmer, more detailed face than the stylised 3D advisers, so hair length and exact colours will not match the 3D models one to one.
- Native Arabic-speaking review of the look (scarf styles, modesty, overall tone) is still worth doing before launch.

## Prompts

Every prompt is `HEAD + description + expression + TAIL`. The full text per adviser, with job ids and result URLs, is in `docs/showroom3d/staff-portraits.json`.

- HEAD: `Photorealistic head-and-shoulders portrait photograph, vertical 3:4, of a fictional professional Gulf Arab woman who works as ...`
- TAIL: `Background: a softly blurred luxury furniture showroom with dark walnut panelling and warm integrated lighting. Lighting: soft warm key light from the front left, gentle fill, subtle rim light. Shot on an 85mm lens at f/2, eye level, shallow depth of field, natural skin texture, minimal natural make-up, not retouched, not glossy. No text, no logos, no watermark.`
- Default expression: `Warm, natural, approachable expression with a gentle smile, looking at the camera, shoulders turned slightly.`

Per adviser description:

- `reception`: a showroom reception adviser. She is in her early thirties with an oval face, light olive skin, dark brown eyes and brown hair pulled back in a neat low bun; no headscarf. She wears a tailored muted deep-teal coat over a cream high-neck blouse, modest and elegant.
- `kitchens`: a kitchen design adviser. She is in her late thirties with a soft rounded face, medium tan skin and warm brown eyes. She wears an elegant black abaya and a cream shayla headscarf neatly draped so her hair is covered, modest and refined.
- `wardrobes`: a wardrobe design adviser. She is in her late twenties with a heart-shaped face, light olive skin, dark eyes and long dark hair worn loose over her shoulders; no headscarf. She wears a tailored muted terracotta-brick coat over an ivory high-neck top, modest and elegant.
- `walkin`: a walk-in closet design adviser. She is in her early forties with high cheekbones, deep brown skin and dark eyes. She wears an elegant deep-plum abaya and a soft grey hijab neatly wrapped so her hair is covered, modest and refined.
- `bedroom`: a bedroom design adviser. She is in her late twenties with a slim face, light olive skin and hazel-brown eyes. She wears an elegant sand-beige abaya and a dusty-rose hijab neatly wrapped so her hair is covered, modest and refined.
- `doors`: an interior door adviser. She is in her mid forties with defined features, fine laugh lines, medium tan skin and dark eyes. She wears an elegant navy abaya and a cream shayla headscarf neatly draped so her hair is covered, modest and refined. Expression: Warm, natural, experienced and approachable expression with a gentle smile, looking at the camera, shoulders turned slightly.
- `living`: a living-room design adviser. She is in her mid thirties with a square jaw, fair olive skin, brown eyes and short chin-length brown hair in a neat bob; no headscarf. She wears a tailored muted deep-teal coat over a soft grey high-neck top, modest and elegant.
- `studio`: a design studio adviser. She is in her early thirties with a long narrow face, light olive skin, dark eyes and thin-framed glasses. She wears an elegant black abaya and a dusty-rose hijab neatly wrapped so her hair is covered, modest and refined. Expression: Warm, natural, thoughtful and approachable expression with a gentle smile, looking at the camera, shoulders turned slightly.
- `lounge`: a customer lounge adviser. She is in her late thirties with a full face, deep brown skin, dark eyes and dark hair in an elegant high bun; no headscarf. She wears a tailored muted terracotta-brick coat over a cream high-neck blouse, modest and elegant.
- `vip`: a senior adviser for private client meetings. She is in her early forties with an elegant angular face, medium tan skin and dark eyes, poised and composed. She wears an elegant navy abaya and a soft grey silk shayla headscarf neatly draped so her hair is covered, modest and refined. Expression: Warm, natural, confident and approachable expression with a gentle smile, looking at the camera, shoulders turned slightly.

## Regenerating

Re-run the same prompt with the same model and settings (0.25 credits each), fit to 768x1024, save as WebP at quality 86, and update `docs/showroom3d/staff-portraits.json`. Keep the shared HEAD / TAIL so a replacement still matches the set.
